The '''JT-9 Jetpack''' was a type of [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] produced by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The MSM JT-9 Jetpack was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the Strategy Alliance Pack.
